focus: Attention Is All You Need, Section 3.2.1. Explain scaled dot-product attention using small, editable Q, K, and V matrices. Show similarity scores, normalized attention weights, and the output. Let the learner edit values and switch scaling on/off. Guide them through equal scores and a dominant score. Check that each row of weights sums to one and that the output equals the weighted sum of V. Do not train a Transformer.
